name: Equilibrium Equations (2D)
expr: ΣFx = 0, ΣFy = 0, ΣM = 0

name: Degree of Static Indeterminacy
expr: DSI = (3m + r) − 3n (for plane frames)

name: Degree of Kinematic Indeterminacy (concept)
expr: concept: number of independent joint displacements needed to fully define the deformed shape of a structure

name: Method of Joints (Truss) (concept)
expr: concept: analyzes truss member forces by applying force equilibrium at each joint successively

name: Method of Sections (Truss) (concept)
expr: concept: analyzes truss member forces by cutting through the truss and applying equilibrium to one part

name: Zero Force Member Identification (concept)
expr: concept: a truss member carries no force when only two non-collinear members meet at an unloaded joint

name: Influence Line Diagram (concept)
expr: concept: graph showing the variation of a force effect (reaction, shear, moment) at a point as a unit load moves across a structure

name: Maxwell-Betti Reciprocal Theorem (concept)
expr: concept: the deflection at point A due to a load at point B equals the deflection at point B due to the same load at point A

name: Principle of Superposition (concept)
expr: concept: the total effect of multiple loads on a linear elastic structure equals the sum of effects of each load applied separately

name: Virtual Work Method (Deflection) (concept)
expr: concept: computes deflection at a point by equating real and virtual work done by a unit virtual load

name: Shear Force at a Section
expr: V = ΣVertical Forces to One Side of the Section

name: Bending Moment at a Section
expr: M = ΣMoments of Forces to One Side of the Section

name: Relation Between Load, Shear, and Moment
expr: dV/dx = −w, dM/dx = V

name: Maximum Bending Moment – Simply Supported Beam, Point Load at Center
expr: Mmax = WL/4

name: Maximum Bending Moment – Simply Supported Beam, UDL
expr: Mmax = wL²/8

name: Maximum Bending Moment – Cantilever, Point Load at Free End
expr: Mmax = WL

name: Maximum Bending Moment – Cantilever, UDL
expr: Mmax = wL²/2

name: Maximum Bending Moment – Overhanging Beam (concept)
expr: concept: maximum moment occurs either within the span or at the support, depending on the overhang load distribution

name: Deflection – Simply Supported Beam, Point Load at Center
expr: δmax = WL³/(48EI)

name: Deflection – Cantilever, Point Load at Free End
expr: δmax = WL³/(3EI)

name: Deflection – Simply Supported Beam, UDL
expr: δmax = 5wL⁴/(384EI)

name: Macaulay's Method (Beam Deflection) (concept)
expr: concept: uses a single continuous equation with step functions to find deflection for beams with discontinuous loading

name: Moment Area Method (concept)
expr: concept: uses the area of the M/EI diagram between two points to find slope and deflection at those points

name: Conjugate Beam Method (concept)
expr: concept: converts a beam's M/EI diagram into a loading on an imaginary conjugate beam to find slope and deflection directly

name: Fixed End Moments – UDL on Fixed Beam
expr: FEM = wL²/12

name: Fixed End Moments – Point Load at Center on Fixed Beam
expr: FEM = WL/8

name: Slope-Deflection Equation
expr: M = (2EI/L)(2θA + θB − 3ψ) + FEM

name: Moment Distribution Method – Distribution Factor
expr: DF = kmember / Σk(joint)

name: Stiffness of a Member (Far End Fixed)
expr: k = 4EI/L

name: Stiffness of a Member (Far End Pinned)
expr: k = 3EI/L

name: Carry-Over Factor (Far End Fixed)
expr: COF = 1/2

name: Modular Ratio
expr: m = Es/Ec

name: Neutral Axis Depth (Working Stress Method, Balanced Section)
expr: concept: depth at which both concrete and steel reach their allowable stresses simultaneously under working loads

name: Moment of Resistance (Singly Reinforced Beam, WSM)
expr: M = Qbd² (where Q is the moment of resistance factor)

name: Area of Steel Required
expr: Ast = M / (σst × j × d)

name: Limit State Method – Balanced Neutral Axis Depth
expr: xu(max)/d = 0.53 (for Fe250 steel, varies by grade)

name: Ultimate Moment of Resistance (Under-Reinforced Section)
expr: Mu = 0.87fy·Ast·d(1 − Ast·fy/(bd·fck))

name: Minimum Reinforcement (Beam)
expr: Ast(min) = 0.85bd/fy

name: Maximum Reinforcement (Beam)
expr: Ast(max) = 0.04bD

name: Development Length of Reinforcement
expr: Ld = (φσs)/(4τbd)

name: Shear Reinforcement Spacing
expr: Sv = 0.87fy·Asv·d / Vus

name: Nominal Shear Stress
expr: τv = Vu/(bd)

name: Punching Shear Stress (Slabs/Footings)
expr: τv = Vu/(b0 × d)

name: Effective Depth of a Slab
expr: d = D − Clear Cover − φ/2

name: Reinforcement Ratio
expr: p = Ast / (bd)

name: Crack Width Estimation (concept)
expr: concept: estimated maximum crack width based on strain in reinforcement, cover, and bar spacing, per design code provisions

name: Deflection Control – Span to Effective Depth Ratio (concept)
expr: concept: limiting ratio of span to effective depth to control deflection without direct calculation, per code provisions

name: Column Design – Axial Load Capacity
expr: Pu = 0.4fck·Ac + 0.67fy·Asc

name: Slenderness Ratio of a Column
expr: λ = Le/D (or Le/b)

name: Footing Design – Bearing Pressure
expr: q = P/A ± M/Z

name: Permissible Bending Stress (Working Stress Method) (concept)
expr: concept: allowable bending stress specified by code as a fraction of the yield stress of structural steel

name: Section Modulus Required
expr: Z(required) = M / σ(allowable)

name: Slenderness Ratio (Steel Column)
expr: λ = Le/r(min)

name: Euler's Critical Load (Steel Column)
expr: Pcr = π²EI/Le²

name: Shear Capacity of a Bolt
expr: Vsb = (Anb × fu) / (√3 × γmb)

name: Bearing Capacity of a Bolt
expr: Vpb = 2.5 × kb × d × t × fu / γmb

name: Strength of a Fillet Weld (Steel)
expr: P = 0.7s × l × fu / (√3 × γmw)

name: Throat Thickness of a Fillet Weld (Steel)
expr: tt = K × s (K depends on angle between fusion faces)

name: Effective Length of a Compression Member (concept)
expr: concept: length used in buckling calculations, adjusted from actual length based on end support conditions

name: Plastic Section Modulus
expr: Zp = ∫y dA (over the tension and compression zones)

name: Shape Factor (Steel Section)
expr: S = Zp / Ze

name: Local Buckling – Width to Thickness Ratio (concept)
expr: concept: limiting ratio of an element's width to thickness to prevent premature local buckling before yielding

name: Bearing – Whole Circle Bearing (concept)
expr: concept: horizontal angle measured clockwise from north (0° to 360°) to a survey line

name: Reduced Bearing (concept)
expr: concept: bearing expressed as an angle up to 90° from north or south, with a quadrant designation (NE, NW, SE, SW)

name: Latitude of a Survey Line
expr: L = D × cos(θ)

name: Departure of a Survey Line
expr: D(ep) = D × sin(θ)

name: Closing Error (Traverse)
expr: e = √(ΣL)² + (ΣD)²

name: Bowditch's Rule (Traverse Adjustment)
expr: Correction = (Total Error/Total Length) × Length of that Line

name: Area by Coordinates (Traverse)
expr: A = ½|Σ(xi·yi+1 − xi+1·yi)|

name: Simpson's Rule (Area Calculation)
expr: A = (d/3)[O1 + On + 4(Even Offsets) + 2(Odd Offsets)]

name: Reduced Level (Leveling)
expr: RL = Height of Instrument − Staff Reading

name: Height of Instrument (Leveling)
expr: HI = RL(Known Point) + Backsight Reading

name: Arithmetic Check (Leveling)
expr: ΣBS − ΣFS = Last RL − First RL

name: Curvature Correction (Leveling)
expr: Cc = 0.0785D² (D in km, correction in meters, approximate)

name: Refraction Correction (Leveling)
expr: Cr = 0.0112D² (D in km, correction in meters, approximate)

name: Tacheometric Distance (Stadia Method)
expr: D = KS + C (K = multiplying constant, S = staff intercept)

name: Length of a Simple Circular Curve
Tangent Length of a Circular Curve
expr: T = R·tan(Δ/2)

name: Length of Long Chord
expr: LC = 2R·sin(Δ/2)

name: Degree of Curve
expr: D = 1718.9/R (in minutes, chord definition, approximate)

name: External Distance of a Curve
expr: E = R[sec(Δ/2) − 1]

name: Mid-Ordinate of a Curve
expr: M = R[1 − cos(Δ/2)]

name: Super-elevation on a Curve
expr: e = V²/(127R) (V in km/h, R in m)

name: Void Ratio
expr: e = Vv/Vs

name: Porosity
expr: n = Vv/V

name: Relation Between Void Ratio and Porosity
Degree of Saturation
expr: S = Vw/Vv × 100

name: Water Content
expr: w = Ww/Ws × 100

name: Bulk Unit Weight
expr: γ = W/V

name: Dry Unit Weight
expr: γd = γ/(1+w)

name: Specific Gravity of Soil Solids
expr: G = Ws/(Vs × γw)

name: Relation Between e, G, w, and S
expr: eS = wG

name: Saturated Unit Weight
expr: γsat = [(G+e)/(1+e)] × γw

name: Submerged Unit Weight
expr: γ' = γsat − γw

name: Coefficient of Permeability (Darcy's Law)
expr: v = k × i

name: Discharge Velocity (Darcy's Law)
expr: q = k × i × A

name: Seepage Velocity
expr: vs = v/n

name: Coefficient of Consolidation
expr: Cv = Tv × Hdr² / t

name: Compression Index
expr: Cc = Δe / log10(σ2'/σ1')

name: Overconsolidation Ratio
expr: OCR = Preconsolidation Pressure / Present Effective Overburden Pressure

name: Coulomb's Shear Strength Equation
expr: τ = c + σ·tan(φ)

name: Terzaghi's Bearing Capacity Equation
expr: qu = c·Nc + q·Nq + 0.5γB·Nγ

name: Net Safe Bearing Capacity
expr: qns = (qu − γD)/FOS

name: Rankine's Active Earth Pressure Coefficient
expr: Ka = (1−sinφ)/(1+sinφ)

name: Rankine's Passive Earth Pressure Coefficient
expr: Kp = (1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)

name: Active Earth Pressure on a Retaining Wall
expr: Pa = ½Ka·γ·H²

name: Standard Penetration Test N-Value Correlation (concept)
expr: concept: N-value from an SPT test is correlated with soil density, strength, and bearing capacity through empirical relations

name: Proctor Compaction – Maximum Dry Density (concept)
expr: concept: peak dry density achieved at the optimum moisture content during a standard or modified Proctor compaction test

name: Zero Air Voids Line
expr: γd(zav) = G·γw / (1+wG)

name: Field Density by Sand Replacement Method (concept)
expr: concept: determines in-situ soil density by measuring the volume of a hole using calibrated sand and the excavated soil's weight

name: Bearing Capacity of a Pile (Static Formula)
expr: Qu = Qp + Qs (end bearing + skin friction)

name: Group Efficiency of Pile Foundation
expr: η = Qg(actual) / (n × Qu(single pile))

name: Negative Skin Friction (concept)
expr: concept: downward drag force on a pile caused by settling soil around it, adding load rather than resisting it

name: Allowable Load on a Pile
expr: Qa = Qu / FOS

name: Settlement of a Pile Group (concept)
expr: concept: total settlement of a pile group is generally greater than that of a single pile carrying the same average load

name: Combined Footing Design (concept)
expr: concept: a single footing supporting two or more columns, proportioned so the resultant load passes through its centroid

name: Raft Foundation Bearing Pressure
expr: q = P/A ± M/Z (average pressure adjusted for eccentric loading)

name: Overtaking Sight Distance (concept)
expr: concept: minimum distance required for a vehicle to safely overtake another vehicle on a two-lane road

name: Camber (Cross Slope) of a Pavement (concept)
expr: concept: slight cross-fall provided on a road surface to drain rainwater quickly to the sides

name: Gradient – Ruling Gradient (concept)
expr: concept: maximum gradient within which a highway designer must fit the vertical alignment under normal conditions

name: Length of Summit Curve (Sight Distance Criterion)
expr: L = NS²/(√(2h1)+√(2h2))² (for S < L)

name: Length of Valley Curve (Comfort Criterion)
expr: L = NV²/C (C is comfort constant)

name: Equivalent Single Axle Load (concept)
expr: concept: converts mixed traffic axle loads into an equivalent number of standard single-axle load repetitions for pavement design

name: California Bearing Ratio
expr: CBR = (Test Load / Standard Load) × 100

name: Flexible Pavement Thickness (Group Index / CBR Method) (concept)
expr: concept: pavement thickness determined empirically based on subgrade CBR value and expected traffic loading

name: Rigid Pavement – Warping Stress (concept)
expr: concept: stress induced in a concrete pavement slab due to temperature differential between the top and bottom surfaces

name: Skid Resistance (Pavement) (concept)
expr: concept: measure of the friction between a vehicle's tires and the pavement surface, important for safe stopping

name: Traffic Volume Count Rate
expr: Volume = Number of Vehicles / Time Period

name: Peak Hour Factor
expr: PHF = Total Hourly Volume / (4 × Peak 15-min Volume)

name: Capacity of a Highway Lane (concept)
expr: concept: maximum sustainable flow rate a lane can carry under prevailing roadway and traffic conditions

name: Chezy's Equation
expr: V = C√(RS)

name: Hydraulic Radius
expr: R = A/P (flow area / wetted perimeter)

name: Froude Number (Open Channel)
expr: Fr = V/√(gD)

name: Specific Energy (Open Channel Flow)
expr: E = y + V²/(2g)

name: Duty of Water
expr: D = 8.64B/Δ (B = base period in days, Δ = delta in meters)

name: Discharge of a Canal
expr: Q = A × V

name: Lacey's Regime Equations (concept)
expr: concept: empirical relations describing the stable cross-section, slope, and velocity of an alluvial channel in regime condition

name: Rational Method (Peak Runoff)
expr: Q = CiA/360 (Q in m³/s, i in mm/hr, A in hectares)

name: Runoff Coefficient (concept)
expr: concept: dimensionless ratio of runoff volume to total rainfall volume, dependent on land use and soil type

name: Time of Concentration (concept)
expr: concept: time required for runoff to travel from the most hydraulically distant point of a watershed to its outlet

name: Reservoir Capacity – Mass Curve Method (concept)
expr: concept: determines required reservoir storage by analyzing the cumulative inflow mass curve against demand

name: Free Board of a Dam (concept)
expr: concept: additional height provided above the maximum water level of a dam to prevent overtopping by waves or surges

name: Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD)
expr: BOD = (DO1 − DO2) × Dilution Factor

name: Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD) (concept)
expr: concept: measure of the total oxygen required to chemically oxidize organic and inorganic matter in water

name: BOD Rate Equation (First Order)
expr: BODt = BODu(1 − 10^(−kt))

name: Population Forecasting – Arithmetic Increase Method
expr: Pn = P0 + n × Average Increase

name: Population Forecasting – Geometric Increase Method
expr: Pn = P0(1 + r)^n

name: Design Period (Water Supply Systems) (concept)
expr: concept: future time period for which a water supply or sewerage system is designed to adequately serve the projected population

name: Per Capita Demand of Water
expr: Per Capita Demand = Total Water Consumption / Population

name: Detention Time (Sedimentation Tank)
expr: t = V/Q

name: Surface Overflow Rate (Sedimentation Tank)
expr: SOR = Q/A

name: Weir Loading Rate
expr: WLR = Q/L(weir length)

name: Filtration Rate (Rapid Sand Filter)
expr: Filtration Rate = Q/A

name: Coagulant Dosage (concept)
expr: concept: optimum amount of coagulant chemical added to water to destabilize suspended particles for effective flocculation

name: Chlorine Demand
expr: Chlorine Demand = Chlorine Dosed − Chlorine Residual

name: Sludge Volume Index (concept)
expr: concept: volume occupied by one gram of activated sludge after settling, indicating sludge settleability

name: Air Pollution – Dispersion Modeling (concept)
expr: concept: predicts downwind pollutant concentration based on emission rate, wind speed, and atmospheric stability

name: Solid Waste Generation Rate
expr: Generation Rate = Total Waste Collected / (Population × Time)

name: Quantity of Cement in Concrete (Volumetric Method) (concept)
expr: concept: cement quantity estimated from the dry volume of concrete and the mix proportion (e.g., 1:2:4)

name: Dry Volume of Concrete
expr: Dry Volume = 1.54 × Wet Volume (approximate, accounting for voids)

name: Bulking of Sand (concept)
expr: concept: apparent increase in volume of sand due to a film of water separating individual sand particles

name: Rate Analysis of an Item (concept)
expr: concept: detailed cost estimation for one unit of a construction item, including material, labor, and equipment costs

name: Critical Path Method (concept)
expr: concept: identifies the longest sequence of dependent activities that determines the minimum project duration

name: Total Float (Project Scheduling)
expr: TF = LS − ES (or LF − EF)

name: Free Float (Project Scheduling)
expr: FF = ES(next activity) − EF(current activity)

name: Earned Value
expr: EV = % Complete × Budgeted Cost

name: Cost Performance Index
expr: CPI = EV/AC

name: Schedule Performance Index
expr: SPI = EV/PV

name: Bill of Quantities Estimation (concept)
expr: concept: itemized list of construction quantities with rates, used to determine the overall project cost

name: Labor Productivity (Construction)
expr: Productivity = Output Quantity / Labor Hours

name: Formwork Quantity Estimation (concept)
expr: concept: surface area of formwork calculated from the contact surface of concrete elements requiring temporary support

name: Compressive Strength of Concrete
expr: fc = P/A (failure load / cross-sectional area)

name: Water-Cement Ratio
expr: w/c = Weight of Water / Weight of Cement

name: Slump Test (Workability) (concept)
expr: concept: measures the consistency and workability of fresh concrete by the vertical settlement of a standard cone of concrete

name: Fineness Modulus of Aggregate
expr: FM = ΣCumulative % Retained / 100

name: Specific Gravity of Aggregate
expr: G = Weight of Aggregate / Weight of Equal Volume of Water

name: Bulk Density of Aggregate
expr: Bulk Density = Mass of Aggregate / Volume of Container

name: Modulus of Elasticity of Concrete
expr: Ec = 5000√fck (approximate, per code provisions)

name: Characteristic Strength of Concrete (concept)
expr: concept: strength below which not more than 5% of test results are expected to fall

name: Brick Absorption Test (concept)
expr: concept: measures the percentage increase in a brick's weight after 24-hour water immersion, indicating porosity

name: Compressive Strength of a Brick
expr: fb = Failure Load / Bearing Area

name: Prestress Force Required
expr: P = M/e (approximate, for a given eccentricity)

name: Loss of Prestress due to Elastic Shortening
expr: ΔP = Es/Ec × P/A

name: Loss of Prestress due to Creep
expr: ΔP(creep) = φ × (P/A) × Es/Ec

name: Loss of Prestress due to Shrinkage
expr: ΔP(shrinkage) = εsh × Es × A

name: Loss of Prestress due to Relaxation of Steel (concept)
expr: concept: gradual reduction in stress in a prestressing tendon held at constant strain over time

name: Loss of Prestress due to Friction
expr: Px = P0 × e^(−(μα+kx))

name: Anchorage Slip Loss
expr: ΔP = (ΔL/L) × Es × A

name: Resultant Stress in a Prestressed Section
expr: σ = P/A ± Pe·y/I ± M·y/I

name: Kern Distance (Prestressed Section) (concept)
expr: concept: limiting eccentricity within which the prestressing force can be applied without inducing tensile stress in the section

name: Seismic Base Shear (Equivalent Static Method)
expr: VB = Ah × W

name: Fundamental Natural Period of a Building (Empirical)
expr: T = 0.075h^0.75 (RC frame buildings, approximate)

name: Response Reduction Factor (concept)
expr: concept: factor accounting for a structure's ductility and overstrength, reducing the elastic seismic design force

name: Importance Factor (Seismic Design) (concept)
expr: concept: factor increasing seismic design force for structures of higher functional importance, such as hospitals

name: Storey Drift Limitation (concept)
expr: concept: code-specified limit on the relative lateral displacement between consecutive floors under design seismic force

name: Wind Pressure on a Structure
expr: p = 0.6Vz²

name: Design Wind Speed
expr: Vz = Vb × k1 × k2 × k3 × k4

name: Wind Load on a Building
expr: F = Cf × Ae × pd

name: Gust Factor (concept)
expr: concept: factor accounting for short-duration wind speed peaks (gusts) above the mean wind speed in structural design

name: Response Spectrum Method (concept)
expr: concept: seismic analysis method using a structure's natural periods and a design response spectrum to estimate peak responses

name: Live Load Distribution on a Bridge Deck (concept)
expr: concept: method of distributing wheel loads to bridge girders based on their relative stiffness and spacing

name: Impact Factor (Bridge Loading)
expr: IF = 4.5/(6+L) (approximate, per IRC provisions, L in meters)

name: Effective Span of a Bridge (concept)
expr: concept: distance between the centers of bearings, used for structural analysis of a bridge superstructure

name: Camber in a Bridge Girder (concept)
expr: concept: slight upward curvature built into a girder to compensate for anticipated dead load and long-term deflection

name: Bearing Capacity of a Bridge Pier (concept)
expr: concept: maximum load a bridge pier foundation can safely support, determined from soil and structural considerations

name: Scour Depth at a Bridge Pier (concept)
expr: concept: estimated depth of erosion around a pier foundation caused by flowing water, critical for foundation design

name: Skew Angle Effect on Bridge Design (concept)
expr: concept: influence of a non-perpendicular crossing angle on the distribution of forces in a bridge superstructure

name: Permissible Bending Stress in Timber (concept)
expr: concept: allowable bending stress for a timber species and grade, specified by code based on its structural properties

name: Timber Beam Design (Bending)
expr: σ = M/Z ≤ Permissible Stress

name: Slenderness Ratio of a Masonry Wall
expr: SR = Effective Height / Effective Thickness

name: Permissible Compressive Stress in Masonry (concept)
expr: concept: allowable stress for masonry, reduced by factors for slenderness and eccentricity of loading

name: Eccentricity Reduction Factor (Masonry) (concept)
expr: concept: factor reducing the permissible stress in masonry design to account for load eccentricity

name: Shape Factor (Masonry Units) (concept)
expr: concept: factor adjusting the compressive strength of a masonry unit based on its height-to-width ratio

name: Mortar Mix Ratio (concept)
expr: concept: proportion of cement, sand, and sometimes lime used in mortar, selected based on required strength and durability

name: Factor of Safety Against Overturning (Retaining Wall)
expr: FOS = Resisting Moment / Overturning Moment

name: Factor of Safety Against Sliding (Retaining Wall)
expr: FOS = Resisting Force / Driving Force

name: Factor of Safety Against Bearing Failure (Retaining Wall)
expr: FOS = Ultimate Bearing Capacity / Maximum Applied Pressure

name: Coulomb's Earth Pressure Theory (concept)
expr: concept: computes active/passive earth pressure considering wall friction and a sloped backfill surface, using a trial wedge approach

name: Factor of Safety Against Slope Failure (Slope Stability)
expr: FOS = Resisting Shear Strength / Mobilized Shear Stress

name: Swedish Slip Circle Method (concept)
expr: concept: method of slices used to analyze slope stability by summing resisting and driving moments about the center of a trial slip circle

name: Fellenius Method (Slope Stability) (concept)
expr: concept: simplified method of slices assuming inter-slice forces are parallel and their net effect is negligible

name: Bishop's Simplified Method (concept)
expr: concept: an improved method of slices that accounts for inter-slice normal forces, giving a more accurate factor of safety

name: Abrams' Water-Cement Ratio Law (concept)
expr: concept: concrete strength is inversely related to the water-cement ratio for a given set of materials and curing conditions

name: Gain of Strength with Age (concept)
expr: concept: concrete strength increases with curing age, with the rate of gain slowing over time

name: Curing Period (concept)
expr: concept: minimum time concrete must be kept moist to achieve adequate hydration and design strength

name: Rebound Hammer Test (concept)
expr: concept: non-destructive test estimating concrete surface hardness/strength from the rebound of a spring-loaded hammer

name: Ultrasonic Pulse Velocity Test (concept)
expr: concept: non-destructive test assessing concrete quality and uniformity by measuring the speed of an ultrasonic pulse through it

name: Core Test (Concrete Strength) (concept)
expr: concept: extracting and testing a cylindrical concrete core to estimate in-situ compressive strength

name: Shrinkage of Concrete (concept)
expr: concept: reduction in concrete volume over time due to loss of moisture, occurring even without applied load

name: Creep of Concrete (concept)
expr: concept: gradual, time-dependent increase in concrete strain under sustained constant stress

name: Segregation of Concrete (concept)
expr: concept: separation of coarse aggregate from the mortar matrix in fresh concrete, reducing quality and strength

name: Bleeding of Concrete (concept)
expr: concept: appearance of water on the surface of freshly placed concrete due to settlement of solid particles

name: Mix Design – Target Mean Strength
expr: fck(target) = fck + 1.65s

name: Standard Deviation (Concrete Mix Design)
expr: s = √[Σ(fi−fm)²/(n−1)]

name: Horizontal Angle Measurement (Theodolite) (concept)
expr: concept: angle between two survey lines measured by taking the difference of readings on the horizontal circle

name: Trigonometric Leveling – Height of an Object
expr: h = D × tan(θ)

name: Total Station Coordinate Determination (concept)
expr: concept: determines a point's 3D coordinates using measured horizontal/vertical angles and slope distance from a known station

name: GPS Positioning – Trilateration (concept)
expr: concept: determines a receiver's position by measuring distances from at least four satellites with known positions

name: Datum and Coordinate System (concept)
expr: concept: reference surface and coordinate framework used to define positions consistently across a survey

name: Contour Interval (concept)
expr: concept: constant vertical distance between two adjacent contour lines on a topographic map

name: Photogrammetry Scale (concept)
expr: Scale = f/H (focal length / flying height above ground)

name: Remote Sensing Spatial Resolution (concept)
expr: concept: smallest ground feature size that can be distinguished in a satellite or aerial image

name: Excavator Cycle Time (concept)
expr: concept: total time for one complete excavation cycle, including dig, swing, dump, and return

name: Excavator Production Rate
expr: Production = (Bucket Capacity × Efficiency Factor × 3600) / Cycle Time

name: Dump Truck Cycle Time (concept)
expr: concept: total time for a haul truck to load, travel, dump, and return for the next load

name: Concrete Pump Output Rate (concept)
expr: concept: volume of concrete a pump can deliver per hour, dependent on pump capacity and pipeline conditions

name: Crane Load Chart Capacity (concept)
expr: concept: maximum safe lifting capacity of a crane at a given boom angle and radius, per manufacturer's load chart

name: Compaction Equipment Coverage Rate (concept)
expr: concept: area a roller or compactor can effectively compact per unit time, based on width, speed, and passes required

name: Overhead Cost Percentage
expr: Overhead % = (Total Overhead Cost / Direct Cost) × 100

name: Contractor's Profit Margin
expr: Profit % = (Bid Price − Total Cost) / Total Cost × 100

name: Escalation Cost Adjustment (concept)
expr: concept: contract price adjustment to account for material/labor cost increases over the project duration

name: Retention Money (concept)
expr: concept: percentage of each payment withheld by the owner until project completion, ensuring contractor performance

name: Variation Order Cost Impact (concept)
expr: concept: additional or reduced cost resulting from changes to the original scope of work during construction

name: Liquidated Damages (concept)
expr: concept: pre-agreed compensation payable by a contractor for each day of delay beyond the contractual completion date

name: Embodied Energy of a Material (concept)
expr: concept: total energy consumed in extracting, processing, and transporting a construction material to the site

name: Carbon Footprint of a Building (concept)
expr: concept: total greenhouse gas emissions associated with a building's construction and operation

name: Rainwater Harvesting Potential
expr: Potential Volume = Catchment Area × Rainfall × Runoff Coefficient

name: Daylight Factor (concept)
expr: concept: ratio of indoor illuminance at a point to outdoor illuminance under overcast sky conditions, expressed as a percentage

name: Building Energy Efficiency Ratio (concept)
expr: concept: ratio comparing a building's actual energy use to a baseline or reference building's energy use

name: Plate Girder Web Depth (concept)

name: Stiffener Spacing in a Plate Girder (concept)
expr: concept: spacing of vertical stiffeners chosen to prevent web buckling under shear stress

name: Flange Area of a Plate Girder (Approximate)

name: Composite Deck Slab Design (concept)
expr: concept: design considers combined action of a concrete deck slab and steel girder connected by shear studs

name: Shear Connector Capacity (Composite Beam) (concept)
expr: concept: load capacity of a shear stud connecting a concrete slab to a steel beam, resisting horizontal shear at the interface

name: Unit Hydrograph (concept)
expr: concept: hydrograph representing the runoff response of a watershed to one unit of effective rainfall over a unit duration

name: Infiltration Rate (Horton's Equation)

name: Rainfall Intensity-Duration-Frequency Relation (concept)
expr: concept: relationship expressing how rainfall intensity varies with storm duration for a given return period

name: Flood Frequency Analysis (concept)
expr: concept: statistical method estimating the probability of a flood of a given magnitude occurring in any given year

name: Base Flow Separation (concept)
expr: concept: technique for separating a hydrograph into surface runoff and groundwater contribution (base flow)

name: Evapotranspiration Estimation (Penman Method) (concept)

name: Kani's Method (concept)
expr: concept: an iterative method for analyzing indeterminate structures using rotation and displacement factors at each joint

name: Portal Method (Lateral Load Analysis) (concept)
expr: concept: approximate method assuming points of contraflexure at mid-height of columns and mid-span of beams for lateral load analysis

name: Cantilever Method (Lateral Load Analysis) (concept)
expr: concept: approximate method assuming column axial stresses vary linearly with distance from the centroid of the frame, for tall/slender buildings

name: Column Analogy Method (concept)
expr: concept: analyzes indeterminate beams/frames by treating the M/EI diagram as a load on an imaginary 'column' cross-section

name: Strain Energy Method (concept)
expr: concept: computes deflection or redundant forces using the principle that strain energy stored equals external work done

name: Castigliano's First Theorem

expr: concept: partial derivative of strain energy with respect to a redundant force equals zero for a compatible, continuous structure

name: Unit Load Method (concept)
expr: concept: computes deflection at a point using real bending moments and moments due to a unit virtual load applied at that point

name: Degree of Redundancy (concept)
expr: concept: number of extra unknown forces or reactions in a structure beyond what static equilibrium alone can determine

name: One-Way Slab Design (concept)
expr: concept: a slab spanning primarily in one direction, designed as a series of beam strips of unit width

name: Two-Way Slab Design (concept)
expr: concept: a slab spanning in both directions, with moments distributed based on the ratio of long to short span

name: Effective Span of a Slab (concept)
expr: concept: taken as the clear span plus effective depth, or center-to-center of supports, whichever is smaller

name: Distribution Steel in a Slab (concept)
expr: concept: reinforcement placed perpendicular to the main steel to distribute loads and control shrinkage/temperature cracking

name: Waist Slab Thickness (Staircase) (concept)
expr: concept: thickness of the inclined slab portion of a staircase, designed to resist bending under stair loading

name: Going and Rise of a Staircase (concept)
expr: concept: 'going' is the horizontal projection of a step (tread), 'rise' is the vertical height of a step

name: Effective Span of a Staircase (concept)
expr: concept: taken as the horizontal distance between the centers of the supporting beams or landings

name: Response of a SDOF System to Harmonic Loading (concept)

name: Base Isolation (concept)

name: Tuned Mass Damper (concept)
expr: concept: auxiliary mass-spring-damper system attached to a structure to counteract and reduce excessive vibrations

name: Modal Analysis (concept)
expr: concept: technique for determining a structure's natural frequencies and mode shapes to understand its dynamic behavior

name: Response Spectrum (concept)
expr: concept: plot of maximum response (acceleration, velocity, or displacement) of SDOF systems with varying natural periods to a given ground motion

name: Marshall Stability Test (concept)
expr: concept: test measuring the maximum load a compacted asphalt sample can withstand before failure, used in bitumen mix design

name: Optimum Bitumen Content (concept)
expr: concept: bitumen percentage in an asphalt mix that gives the best balance of stability, durability, and workability

name: Penetration Test (Bitumen) (concept)

name: Softening Point of Bitumen (concept)
expr: concept: temperature at which bitumen softens enough to allow a standard steel ball to fall through it a specified distance

name: Ductility Test (Bitumen) (concept)
expr: concept: measures the distance a standard briquette of bitumen stretches before breaking, indicating its ductile properties

name: Rigid Pavement – Westergaard's Stress Equation (Interior Loading) (concept)

name: Terzaghi's Bearing Capacity Factors (concept)

name: Skempton's Bearing Capacity Factor (concept)

name: Meyerhof's Bearing Capacity Equation (concept)

name: Pile Load Test (concept)

name: Under-Reamed Pile Capacity (concept)
expr: concept: bearing capacity of a pile with an enlarged base (bulb), providing additional resistance in expansive soils

name: Sheet Pile Wall Design (concept)
expr: concept: design of a thin retaining wall driven into soil, analyzed for active/passive pressure equilibrium and embedment depth

name: Center Line Method (Estimation) (concept)
expr: concept: estimation technique computing total quantity by multiplying the centerline length of walls/footings by cross-sectional area

name: Long Wall–Short Wall Method (concept)
expr: concept: estimation technique treating longer walls at full length and shorter walls at reduced (crossing) length for quantity calculation

name: Plinth Area Estimate (concept)

name: Cube Rate Method (Estimation) (concept)

name: Sinking Fund for Building Replacement

name: Design Discharge for a Water Distribution Pipe (concept)

name: Pipe Network Analysis – Hardy Cross Method (Water Supply) (concept)

name: Service Reservoir Capacity (concept)
expr: concept: storage capacity sized to balance fluctuations between supply rate and variable consumer demand over the day

name: Fire Demand (Water Supply) (concept)
expr: concept: additional water supply capacity required to meet firefighting needs, often the governing design factor for smaller systems

name: Pumping Main Design (concept)
expr: concept: pipe diameter selected to balance capital cost against pumping (energy) cost over the system's design life

name: Design of a Sewer – Self-Cleansing Velocity (concept)

name: Peak Factor (Sewage Flow) (concept)

name: Sewer Design – Partial Flow Diagram (concept)

name: Damp Proof Course (DPC) (concept)

name: Plastering Thickness (concept)

name: Brick Masonry Bond (concept)

name: Fire Resistance Rating of a Structural Element (concept)

name: Thermal Insulation U-Value

name: Sound Transmission Class (concept)
expr: concept: rating indicating how effectively a building partition reduces airborne sound transmission

name: Effective Green Time (concept)

name: Saturation Flow Rate (concept)
expr: concept: maximum rate of vehicle discharge from a signalized approach during continuous green time

name: Level of Service (Traffic) (concept)

name: Parking Demand Estimation (concept)

name: Coefficient of Velocity (concept)

name: Normal Depth (Open Channel Flow) (concept)

name: Regime Channel Design – Lacey's Wetted Perimeter

name: Silt Ejector Function (concept)

name: Cross Drainage Works (concept)

name: Spacing of Main Reinforcement Bars (concept)

expr: concept: minimum embedment length required for a reinforcement bar to develop its full design stress at a support

name: Shear Wall Design (concept)
expr: concept: design of a vertical wall element resisting lateral loads primarily through in-plane shear action

name: Free Board of a Canal (concept)

name: Aqueduct Design (concept)
expr: concept: structure carrying a canal over a natural drainage, designed considering both hydraulic and structural loads

name: Culvert Design – Discharge Capacity (concept)

name: Plastic Hinge Formation (concept)

name: Collapse Load Analysis (concept)
expr: concept: determines the load at which a structure forms enough plastic hinges to become a mechanism and collapse

name: Dewatering System Design (concept)

name: Design Storm Return Period (concept)

name: Dam Spillway Capacity Design (concept)

expr: concept: factor applied to increase characteristic loads to design loads, accounting for uncertainty in load estimation
